description: Implementation of the ClearKeySessionLibrary class managing ClearKey CAS sessions, including singleton pattern, session addition, lookup, and destruction.

classes.name: ClearKeyCasSession
classes.description: Represents a ClearKey Content Access Session, associated with a plugin and containing key info.

classes.name: ClearKeySessionLibrary
classes.description: Singleton class managing all ClearKey CAS sessions, providing methods to add, find, and destroy sessions.

methods.name: ClearKeySessionLibrary::get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the session library, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ClearKeySessionLibrary::addSession
methods.description: Creates a new session, assigns a session ID, and stores it in the session map.

methods.name: ClearKeySessionLibrary::findSession
methods.description: Retrieves a session by its session ID.

methods.name: ClearKeySessionLibrary::destroySession
methods.description: Removes a session identified by its session ID.

methods.name: ClearKeySessionLibrary::destroyPlugin
methods.description: Removes all sessions associated with a specific plugin.
